'''Shesharile 5''' was one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] orbiting a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile system]], located in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. It was the only populated moon of the [[Star system/Legends|system]] alongside [[Shesharile 6]].<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

==Description==
Heavily-settled, the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was thickly overlaind with industry. Despite this, as of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] such industry was considered to be outdated, with the world's economy being kept alive mainly by the cheap cost of labor.<ref name="GG6" />

Shesharile 5 was extremely dirty, so much that it was considered impossible to escape the filth and pollution when visiting it. The entire moon was considered a 'garbage-[[Planet/Legends|planet]]' and even though there are a few resorts for the very rich on its surface, even them were considered dirty by [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic standards]].<ref name="GG6" />

==History==
===Before the decline===
Before the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] had begun, [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile]] was a thriving industrial and commercial system. The entirety of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was full of life and activity. Most of Shesharile 5 and [[Shesharile 6|6]]'s exports were to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]], especially in the form of ammunition.<ref name="GG6" />

===After the decline===
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] began to divert its resources towards the building of a [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] battlestation, some of the minor industries that used to supply conventional weaponry were left behind. Exports from the remote [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] were not considered worth spending [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] on anymore and the [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile system]], which mainly supplied ammunitions, saw all of his deals with the Empire terminated. The Imperial pullout quickly destroyed the [[Star system/Legends|system]]'s economy, starting the greatest depression the Cluster had ever seen.<ref name="GG6" />

==Society==
Both Shesharile 5 and [[Shesharile 6]] were ruled by the same [[Star system/Legends|system]]-wide government. [[Dutan Mining Supply Exports]] and the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]] were also based on the moon.<ref name="GG6" />

===After the decline===
With the depression, various [[City/Legends|city]] governments hired private [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]]and criminal gangs to keep the order. In many cases, such enforcements later took control of the governent that had employed them.<ref name="GG6" /> Shesharile 5's crowded and run-down industrial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Gallisport]] had recruited a law enforcement agency called the [[Legally Authorized Law Authorities]] to keep in line places that official security forces were unwilling to patrol.<ref name="AJ6" />

The [[Shesharile system/Legends|system]] as a whole saw an enormous increase in drugrunning, with a variety of narcotics becoming the new major exports of the world. The discovery of a new addictive [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] by [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Shlith-dan]] only worsened the moon's decline.<ref name="GG6" />

The value of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]'s own currency saw a depreciation of 98%, with many [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] insisting upon being paid in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial credits]] or precious [[Metal/Legends|metals]] instead.<ref name="GG6" />
